**Document type and provenance**
Sheet A12.1 is an architectural furniture plan drawing produced by TMP ARCHITECTURE INC for the Troy School District. It was included in the Board of Education materials dated October 14, 2025. The drawing title reads "First Level Furniture Plan (FOR REFERENCE ONLY)" and the project title block reads "DISTRICT ADMINISTRATION BUILDING". The project location is given as Troy, MI and the owner as Troy School District. The architect's title block lists the firm address as 1191 WEST SQUARE LAKE ROAD, BLOOMFIELD HILLS, MICHIGAN, 48302, with PH 248.338.4561 and EM INFO@TMP-ARCHITECTURE.COM. The title block includes standard reserved fields for REGISTRATION SEAL, CONSULTANT, ISSUE DATES, DRAWN, CHECKED, APPROVED, PROJECT NO., DRAWING NO., PROJECT TITLE, DRAWING TITLE, and a "DATE: ISSUED FOR:" issue-log column.

**Identifiers, dates and source file**
PROJECT NO. is 22106. DRAWING NO. is A12.1. The DRAWN, CHECKED and APPROVED fields carry the unedited Revit default values "Author", "Checker" and "Approver" rather than named individuals. The plot stamp reads 8/13/2025 4:44:13 PM, and the source model path is recorded as Autodesk Docs://22106_Troy Admin/22106_Arch-23.rvt. The issue log carries two entries: 07-21-2025, CONSTRUCTION DOCUMENTS; and 09-02-2025, ISSUED FOR PRICING.

**Plan view and scale**
The sheet carries a single plan view titled "FIRST LEVEL FURNITURE PLAN - ZONE 'A'", drawn at SCALE: 1/8" = 1'-0", with a north arrow indicated. Additional plan-level annotations that survive in the text layer include "DN", a stair or ramp down indicator, and a dimension note reading 1'4"H.

Service and support: TOILET 106, CUSTODIAL 107, TOILET 109, CORRIDOR 110, TOILET 111, WORK RM. 112, MECH. 113, BOILER ROOM 114, MENS TOILET 115, WOMENS TOILET 116. Office wing: CONF. 119, OFFICE 120, OFFICE 121, TOILET 121B, CLOSET 121C, OFFICE 122, OFFICE 123, OFFICE 124, OFFICE 125, OFFICE 126, OFFICE 127, OFFICE 128, OFFICE 129, OFFICE 130, OFFICE 131, OFFICE 132, OFFICE 134, OFFICE 137, OFFICE 138. Workstation zones (tagged W.S.): 131A, 131B, 131C, 139, 145, 145A, 145B, 145C, 145D, 145E, 145F, 145G. Shared and technical spaces: WORK RM. 135, CONF. 136, FLEX 143, MDF 144, CONF. 146, CLOSET 147, CLOSET 150, BOARD ROOM 152, STORAGE 152B, BREAK ROOM 154, and CORRIDOR C1.

**Furniture keying**
Furniture is keyed to the plan with A-series and B-series tags, some carrying parenthetical quantities. Tags present on the sheet include B1(2), B2, A1, A2(6), A2(10), A2(14), A3, A4(4), A4(6), A5(2), A6(2), A7(6), A8(2), A9(2), A10, A11, A12, A13, A14, A15, A16, A17, A18, A19, A20(2), A21, A22A, A22B, A23, A24, A25A(2), A25B(2), A26, A27, A28, A29, A30, A31, A32, A33A, A33B, A34, A35 and A36. Tags A28, A33A, A33B, A21, A8(2) and A1 recur across multiple locations on the plan.

**Manufacturer and finish coding**
Each furniture line in the sheet's schedule data carries the manufacturer designator HAW, a catalog model number, an application descriptor, and a finish/fabric code. The finish codes appearing are 1HZ2, 1HPA, 1HAS, 1HAK, 1HAF, 1HAW, 1HBH, 1HCC, 1HHK, 1HHM, 1HHN, 1HHO, 1HSV, 1HZY and 1RSS.

**Application descriptors used**
Rather than room names, the schedule entries carry short functional descriptors: "6 pod wrk" (the most frequently used), "3 pod wrk", "med conf rm", "interior offices", "office opt 3", "office opt two", "office round table & chairs", "open area files", "open area high top", "super office", and "judy" (an occupant-specific tag).

**Workstation and panel system components**
The dominant product family on the plan is the VZ series used to build the workstation pods. Frames and panels appear as VZFF-5024-NNBBNR, VZFF-5024-N3HBNR, VZFF-5024-NNHBNR, VZFF-5030-N3HBNR, VZFF-5030-N3BBNR, VZFF-5030-N3HHNR, VZFF-5036-N3BHNR, VZFF-5036-N3BBNR, VZFF-5036-NNBHNR, VZFF-5048-N3HBNR, VZFF-5048-NNBBNR, VZFF-3454-N3HBNR and VZFF-3430-N3HBNR. Companion components include VZCC-0024-HS, VZCC-0030-HS, VZCC-0036-HS, VZCC-0048-HS and VZCC-0054-HS; VZEF-0R0P; VZAD-0000-R; VZAR-0000; VZEB-0000-3; work surfaces VZTI-4024-FNN, VZTI-4030-FNN, VZTI-4036-FNN, VZTI-4048-FNN, VZTI-2430-FNN and VZTI-2454-FNN; and trim/end pieces VZCE-5000-H, VZCE-5000-F, VZCT-5000-H, VZCL-5000-H, VZCL-3400-H, VZVE-1600-H and VZVT-1600-H. Storage units in the same family include VZGK-1230-HS4R, VZGK-1236-HS4R and VZGE-0000-HE.

**Seating**
Task and guest seating appears under several model numbers: SCT-20-7111 (the most widely repeated chair), SZG-22-1K, S75-24-01, S7S-44-0H, S7SC-44-0H, S9G-00, S2UC-22-131A1A (specified with the "med conf rm" descriptor), SBSC-2F-711A5K (specified with "open area high top"), SLP-22-TH and STP-P26-TH. Lounge and soft-seating codes include QLM1-4818-ZLLFQLLN, QALA-3006-S, QALB-2448-S, QALS-2418-S and QALD-2415-S.

**Desking, tables and casegoods**
The T-series covers desks, returns and conference tables: TRCE-6476-LJSNCAN, TRCE-6476-LJSNCRN, TRCE-6470-LJSNCMN, TRCE-5882-LJSNCRN, TRCE-5870-LJSNCAN, TRCE-4682-LJSNCRN, TJBA-3CXB-G, TJRA-2976-LJSNCXN, TJRA-2958-LJSNCXN, TCRN-3636-LJSNXC4A, TCRN-3030-LJSNXG7A, TCRN-2424-LJSNDN1, TCRP-3672-LJSJFK4A, TCRP-4284-LJSNDN4, THRA-4896-LFSNAG7P (tagged "open area high top"), TARP-42D2-LJSNBNNN, TARP-60J0-LJSMBNNN, TACD-0900-LF4, TAPL-2409-SA, TAJC-6500 and TA0M-1360-FF. The J-series covers pedestals, files and storage: JLPD-0336-S8 and JLPD-0230-S8A, JFWA-36, JTPL-1830-JYJYS, JTPL-3672-JYJYS, JRFC-1830-F, JLRD-1530-SJ, J2BE-4824-SSER, J2HB-4824-SS8R and J2HJ-5124-SS8RC (tagged "office opt two").

**Other specified items**
Additional codes on the sheet include the ZZ-series screens or brackets ZZBD-1600-PR, ZZBD-1600-PL and ZZBA-0000-PR; the B-series items BAZS-2460-S2NN, BS22-2430-TTNRWNR and BMAL-2460-YYYYS; the X-series items XLAR-3672-JSNTBE, XLWF-2484-JSNNN, X5W5-2430-FSSLLRY, X5W5-2430-FSSLLLY and X5FA-2342-NSBSSYLLY (the last group tagged "super office"); the EU-series items EUER-153P-GS0S, EUDB-0000-HB, EUD1-SF0B-4000 and EUD1-SF0B-3100; the UZGS-1630-PMN and UZGS-1636-PMN units; and WURA-2436-LJSC and WURA-2486-LJSC, both tagged "judy".

**Substantive content and limitations**
The sheet is a layout and specification document only. It records no dollar amounts, no bid or contract award, no vendor contract party beyond the manufacturer designator HAW, no board vote, no policy number and no millage or fund-balance information. Its explicit "(FOR REFERENCE ONLY)" designation on the drawing title, combined with the 09-02-2025 "ISSUED FOR PRICING" entry in the issue log, indicates the furniture layout accompanied the Construction Documents package of 07-21-2025 as background for pricing rather than as a binding construction directive.
